tools.name: flames
tools.description: Takes two names (a, b) and returns the FLAMES relationship word (Friends, Lovers, Affection, Marriage, Enemies or Siblings) with the struck letters and each round. Example input: {"a":"Rahul","b":"Priya"}

tools.name: loveScore
tools.description: Takes two names (a, b) and returns the LOVES letter-count love percentage, with the letter counts and the adding trail. Example input: {"a":"Rahul","b":"Priya"}

tools.name: friendshipScore
tools.description: Takes two names (a, b) and returns the FRIENDS letter-count friendship percentage, with the letter counts and the adding trail. Example input: {"a":"Rahul","b":"Priya"}
